content: Besloten: CortexIQ draait in productie op de VPS in /opt/cortexiq, met docker compose en een server-lokale docker-compose.prod.yml.
The HTTP server listens on port 9090 and serves metrics and the health endpoint.
The MCP server listens on port 8080 over SSE and is the endpoint agents connect to.
Recall combines vector search and PostgreSQL full-text search with reciprocal rank fusion, constant 60.
CORTEXIQ_RECALL_RECENCY_WEIGHT controls how much newer memories are favoured; the half-life is set separately.
CORTEXIQ_RECALL_IMPORTANCE_WEIGHT lets the importance of an episode lower its recall score.
Bo wil dat de agent in het Nederlands antwoordt wanneer de vraag in het Nederlands is gesteld.
Bo prefers incremental work: one clear task per prompt, never ten changes at once.
De backup draait dagelijks via een systemd-timer en schrijft dumps naar /opt/cortexiq/backups.
Restoring a backup requires the --confirm flag to avoid overwriting production by accident.
The embedding model is bge-m3, served locally through Ollama.
The reasoner model extracts facts from episodes during consolidation.
Consolidation runs every five minutes and processes new episodes in batches.
In the evaluation, an auto-merge threshold of 0.98 sat above every measured near-miss.
Een nieuw feit wordt vergeleken met de vijf dichtstbijzijnde bestaande feiten, niet alleen met de dichtstbijzijnde.
Episodes shorter than 24 characters are skipped by the extractor because they state nothing.
The Hermes plugin stores memories under /hermes/<profile> and recalls globally by default.
The Hermes recall scope can be global, base or profile.
De API vereist een bearer token; schrijven vraagt een token met write-scope.
Read-only tokens can recall and query but cannot remember, forget or consolidate.
The Prometheus metric cortexiq_build_info exposes the build version.
reasoner_prompt_tokens_total counts prompt tokens per reasoner stage.
Het project heette eerst Stash en is hernoemd naar CortexIQ; op 18-10-2026 is ook de namespace van /projects/stash naar /projects/cortexiq gegaan.
The initial CortexIQ commit message was feat!: rebrand Stash to CortexIQ.
Contradictions are detected when a new fact gives a different value for the same entity and property.
A superseded fact gets a valid_until timestamp instead of being deleted.
Recall as_of answers what was known at a given moment, including facts that were later superseded.
Goals can have sub-goals and a priority; completing a goal stores notes.
Failures record why an approach failed and what to do instead.
Hypotheses move through proposed, testing, confirmed and rejected.
De walkthrough wordt na elke significante wijziging bijgewerkt, met Findings, Conclusions en Actions.
After one thousand lines the walkthrough continues in a new file, walkthrough2.md.
Bo scaffolds new projects with bolt.new and continues locally in Visual Studio Code.
Kilo Code is used as the coding agent inside Visual Studio Code.
Production runs on a VPS at Strato; the CortexIQ containers listen only on 127.0.0.1.
De UI draait op poort 18101 op de host en bereikt de HTTP server op poort 9090 in de container.
The MCP server is mapped to host port 18100.
The embedding cache stores vectors per text and model in the embedding_cache table.
Importance is a number between 0 and 1 where 0.5 is neutral.
Decay lowers the confidence of facts that are not reinforced; the factor is 0.95 per cycle.
A fact is reinforced when an extraction repeats it; reinforcement raises its confidence.
Hypotheses are auto-confirmed above confidence 0.9.
De extractor mag geen feiten verzinnen: alleen expliciet vermelde claims worden opgeslagen.
Settings stated in the present tense are stored as observations of the moment, not as timeless properties.
The relationship batch size is five facts per reasoner call.
The maximum number of LLM calls per consolidation run is configurable; production recommends 50.
llm_calls_limited reports that a run hit the call budget.
The export command writes episodes and facts as JSON Lines without embeddings.
Import recomputes the embeddings with the configured model.
Namespaces are hierarchical: a path matches itself and all descendants.
Writing to the root namespace / is not possible because it has no namespace row.
Migrations are applied at startup; migration 28 added the run counters.
The Runs tab shows what each consolidation run changed.
Dedup near-misses count facts stored as new while a near-twin above 0.75 already existed.
De Hermes-integratie maakt het namespace van een profiel zelf aan bij de eerste write.
Webhook support is not planned; agents talk to CortexIQ through MCP or the REST API.
Distroless images contain only the static binary, so there is no shell inside the container.
The Dockerfile builds a static Go binary with CGO disabled.
The GitHub repository is Bojanni050/cortexiq and main is the working branch.
Small changes are pushed to main automatically; large changes ask for confirmation first.
